explication: files-to-prompt is a small CLI utility that combines file contents into LLM-ready prompt text. Users provide file or directory paths on the command line or through stdin; the CLI discovers and filters files, reads their contents, formats each file, and writes the result to stdout or a chosen output file. The sampled CLI shows these runtime stages and output modes; the README documents the supported options.
